user.title: Connect to Paperclip
user.description: Enter the address of your Paperclip server, for example {example_url}. A board API key is needed unless the server runs in `local_trusted` mode.

data_description.url: The base URL you open Paperclip at, without `/api`.
data_description.api_key: A board API key (starts with `pcp_board_`). On any computer that can reach the server, run `npx paperclipai auth login --api-base SERVER_URL`, then `npx paperclipai token board create --api-base SERVER_URL --never-expires`, with the server URL above as SERVER_URL. Leave empty for a `local_trusted` server. Agent keys are not supported.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for an HTTPS server with a self-signed certificate.

company.title: Choose a company
company.description: This key can open more than one Paperclip company. Each company is added as its own entry.

data_description.company_id: The company whose agents and issues Home Assistant should follow.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {title}
reauth_confirm.description: Paperclip at {url} rejected the stored key. Enter a new board API key, or leave it empty for a `local_trusted` server.

data_description.api_key: A board API key (starts with `pcp_board_`) for a user who is a member of this company.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Paperclip
reconfigure.description: Change the server address or key, for example {example_url}.

data_description.url: The base URL you open Paperclip at, without `/api`.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for an HTTPS server with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Paperclip. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: Paperclip rejected the key, or the key has no access to any company.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
error.agent_key: That is an agent API key. Use a board API key (it starts with `pcp_board_`).
error.hostname_not_allowed: Paperclip refused this hostname. On the Paperclip server run `npx paperclipai allowed-hostname HOSTNAME` with the host you entered (in Docker, set `PAPERCLIP_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES` instead), restart Paperclip, then try again.
error.no_companies: The key works, but it cannot open any company.
error.company_not_found: The key cannot open the company this entry was set up for.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Paperclip company is already configured.
abort.wrong_company: This entry belongs to a different Paperclip company.

data_description.reply_wait: How long an Assist conversation waits for the agent's reply before answering that the request was sent.
data_description.allow_approvals: Lets the approve and reject actions decide Paperclip approvals. Anyone who can run actions in Home Assistant could then approve hires and budget overrides.
data_description.default_project: Project for issues created from Home Assistant when an action does not name one. Pick it from the list, or type a project name or ID.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Paperclip to look up the project. Pick it from the list or enter its ID.
error.project_not_found: No Paperclip project has that name. Pick a project from the list or enter its ID.

invalid_auth.message: Paperclip rejected the board API key.

hostname_not_allowed.message: Paperclip refused the hostname Home Assistant uses. Allow it on the server with `npx paperclipai allowed-hostname HOSTNAME` (in Docker, set `PAPERCLIP_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES`), then restart Paperclip.

rate_limited.message: Paperclip asked Home Assistant to slow down.

company_not_found.message: The Paperclip company of this entry no longer exists or is not visible to the key.

not_an_agent.message: {agent} is not a Paperclip agent device.

agent_not_found.message: No loaded Paperclip entry has an agent called {agent}.

agent_ambiguous.message: More than one Paperclip agent matches {agent}. Pick the agent device or give the config entry.

agent_wrong_entry.message: {agent} is an agent of {title}, not of the Paperclip entry chosen for this action. Pick an agent of that company.

duplicate_issue_other_assignee.message: Paperclip returned the existing open issue {identifier} with the same title, which is not assigned to {agent}. Turn on "Allow duplicate" to create a new issue for {agent}.

invalid_approval_id.message: The approval ID must be a Paperclip approval UUID, as sent in the paperclip_approval_requested event.

approval_wrong_company.message: That approval does not belong to the Paperclip company of {title}. Use the entry of the company the approval belongs to.

issue_wrong_company.message: Issue {issue} does not belong to the Paperclip company of {title}. Use the entry of the company the issue belongs to.

forbidden.message: Paperclip refused this action for the board API key: {error}

invalid_public_id.message: The routine trigger public ID must be 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or the trigger's full webhook URL.

invalid_payload.message: The webhook payload cannot be sent as JSON: {error}

approvals_disabled.message: Approvals from Home Assistant are turned off for {title}. Turn on "Allow approvals from Home Assistant" in the integration options first.

reply_pending.message: Sent to {agent} as {identifier}. The reply will be in Paperclip.

conversation_failed.message: Sorry, I could not reach Paperclip: {error}

outdated_paperclip.title: Paperclip server is older than supported
outdated_paperclip.description: The Paperclip server for {title} reports version {version}. This integration is tested with {minimum} and newer, so some entities or actions may not work. Update Paperclip to fix this.

ask_agent.name: Ask agent
ask_agent.description: Sends a request to a chosen Paperclip agent as a new issue assigned to it, and optionally waits for the agent's reply.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: The agent device, or an agent ID or name.

message.name: Message
message.description: What you want the agent to do. Becomes the issue description.

title.name: Title
title.description: Issue title. Defaults to the start of the message.

project.name: Project
project.description: Project ID or name. Defaults to the project set in the options.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Issue priority. Paperclip defaults to medium.

wait_for_reply.name: Wait for reply
wait_for_reply.description: Seconds to wait for the agent's first comment (0 to 300). 0 returns at once. Only waits when the reply is used as response data. The reply returned is cut to 2000 characters.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when an agent ID or name could belong to more than one Paperclip entry.

create_issue.name: Create issue
create_issue.description: Creates a Paperclip issue, optionally assigned to an agent (which wakes it).

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: The Paperclip company to act on.

assignee.name: Assignee
assignee.description: An agent of the chosen company: the agent device, or an agent ID or name. Leave empty for an unassigned backlog issue.

project.name: Project
project.description: Project ID or name. Defaults to the project set in the options.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Issue priority. Paperclip defaults to medium.

allow_duplicate.name: Allow duplicate
allow_duplicate.description: Paperclip returns an existing open issue with the same title from the last 48 hours instead of creating a new one, unless this is on. If that issue is assigned to another agent, the action fails.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Adds a comment to a Paperclip issue, which wakes its assignee, and optionally waits for the agent's reply.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: The Paperclip company to act on.

issue.name: Issue
issue.description: Issue ID or identifier, for example ACME-12.

wait_for_reply.name: Wait for reply
wait_for_reply.description: Seconds to wait for an agent comment after yours (0 to 300). Only waits when the reply is used as response data. The reply returned is cut to 2000 characters.

wake_agent.name: Wake agent
wake_agent.description: Starts an on-demand heartbeat run for a Paperclip agent.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: The agent device, or an agent ID or name.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why the agent is being woken. Shown in Paperclip.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when an agent ID or name could belong to more than one Paperclip entry.

fire_routine_webhook.name: Fire routine webhook
fire_routine_webhook.description: Fires a Paperclip routine's webhook trigger, HMAC-SHA256 signed when a secret is given (unsigned otherwise). The board API key is not sent.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: The Paperclip server to send the webhook to.

public_id.name: Public ID
public_id.description: The trigger's public ID (24 hex characters) or its full webhook URL.

secret.name: Signing secret
secret.description: The trigger's webhook secret, for triggers in `hmac_sha256` mode. Leave empty only for unsigned (`none`) triggers.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: JSON object sent as the body. Top-level fields or a nested `variables` object fill routine variables.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Only for unsigned (`none`) triggers: Paperclip runs a delivery with the same key once. Signed triggers ignore it; each call is a new delivery.

approve.name: Approve
approve.description: Approves a pending Paperclip approval. Only works when approvals are allowed in the integration options.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: The Paperclip company to act on.

approval_id.name: Approval ID
approval_id.description: The approval to decide, as sent in the paperclip_approval_requested event.

decision_note.name: Decision note
decision_note.description: Optional note stored with the decision.

reject.name: Reject
reject.description: Rejects a pending Paperclip approval. Only works when approvals are allowed in the integration options.

config_entry_id.name: Paperclip entry
config_entry_id.description: The Paperclip company to act on.

approval_id.name: Approval ID
approval_id.description: The approval to decide, as sent in the paperclip_approval_requested event.

decision_note.name: Decision note
decision_note.description: Optional note stored with the decision.
